# Assets · Logos

1 file under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for zorix-app-icon.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

`zorix-app-icon.png` (512 × 512) is the application icon: a white Z on the brand gradient tile. Use it only where the operating system or a store shows the app. Inside the product, use the BrandMark component (the `layers` icon on the gradient tile, with ZORIX set in `lead`). The tile carries white in both themes; never recolour or outline it.
